topic: Data model recalculation and dataset preparation
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on the necessary steps for recalculating a data model. It was decided that instead of modifying the production environment, a copy of the production dataset should be created in a separate dataset to perform the changes.

Regarding the source data, [me] confirmed aggregating metrics by network and specified the required date range (January 2024 - June 2024). There was discussion about using `session_predicted` from the `ml_2` dataset within the production dataset. It was noted that the existing aggregation for the period before July needs to be recalculated, potentially extending back to January 1st, 2024.
decisions: A copy of the production data will be created in a separate dataset for recalculation.
The source data should cover the period from January 2024 through June 2024.
action_items: [me] to create and provide the `aka_test` dataset.
